decls.name: Theorem23GeometricCriterion
decls.rationale: Theorem 2.3, the geometric criterion: given a sequence of admissible data sharing the primes \(q_1,\ldots,q_t\), with \(f_j \to \infty\), \(h(K_j) \le H^{f_j}\) and \(\gamma = t\log 2 - \log H > 0\), there are \(\delta > 0\) and infinitely many `n` with \(\nu(n) \ge n^{1+\delta}\).
